edition: Unofficial Zork Forest Consequence Physicality Glulx
player_outcomes: forest commands are interpreted as actions in the game world rather than evidence about the real person at the keyboard
the Forest Path tree supports richer examination, touch, smell, listening, kicking, cutting, and impact responses
TIE ROPE TO TREE and USE ROPE ON TREE reuse the existing recoverable material-rope authority instead of creating a second rope system
an intact sack thrown at a tree travels with its contents and lands as one container rather than teleporting its children back to the player
an open or torn sack can spill surviving contents at the impact destination
a glass bottle carried inside a thrown sack can break internally while preserving the canonical bottle-and-water destruction end state
the jewel-encrusted egg carried inside a thrown or dropped sack can become the canonical broken egg without inventing a replacement treasure
THROW BOTTLE AT TREE, THROW EGG AT TREE, and ordinary thrown objects receive object-specific forest consequences
throwing or dropping fragile objects from Up a Tree respects the ten-foot height and places surviving objects on the Forest Path below
the large Forest Path tree can retain a scoreless cosmetic scar without becoming a shortcut around the canonical egg or forest journey
the existing Up a Tree and Canyon View fatal leap choices retain canonical JIGS-UP authority while receiving fuller physical narration
developer environmental reset also clears the Release 1248 cosmetic tree scar without rewinding canonical puzzle progress
boundaries: no player mental-state inference, diagnosis, sadness detector, or behavioral profiling
no real-world self-harm procedure, knot tutorial, suspension model, or instructional injury simulation
no universal physics engine or arbitrary object-pair simulator
no alternate egg, bottle, rope, death, or scoring authority
no felling the journey-critical Forest Path tree or deleting access to the canonical nest and egg
no score awarded for reckless, destructive, or fatal experimentation
no recursive audit or meta-test machinery
no TODO, stub, placeholder behavior, or production cheat verb
